description: How an app's pain points changed over time: compares two archived analyses and labels each theme new / resolved / rising / falling / stable with share deltas (percentage points). Instant (archive read, no LLM). Default: latest vs ~30 days earlier. Returns a note when the app has fewer than two snapshots yet.

appId.description: App Store or Google Play URL, iOS numeric id (e.g. 324684580) or Android package (e.g. com.spotify.music) — get ids from search_apps

store.description: optional — inferred from appId (numeric id / App Store URL → ios, package / Play URL → android)

name: get_pain_trend
title: Pain-point trend
